src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/FileTyp.scope: All 73 source formats, names, descriptions, properties, CV names, directory kinds and FileTypeList filter generation/lookup. Rust enum excludes invalid numeric sentinel values. Source properties are distinct from Rust adapter support.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/FileNam.scope: All four lexical filename helpers, source alias/compression rules and source stripExtension quirks. Iterative compression peeling and checked underflow replace unsafe source behavior.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/FileHan.scope: Native experiment dispatch for DTA, MGF, DTA2D, MS2 and optional mzML; featureXML/consensusXML map dispatch; plain/gzip/bzip2 transport, allowed-input checks, bounded content recognition and atomic path output. Native idXML identification dispatch with source input/output allowlists. Other identification/transition formats, ZIP input, SHA1 and full source-file bookkeeping remain.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/KERNEL/Standar.scope: All three aliases map directly to existing MSSpectrum, MSExperiment and MSChromatogram. No alias wrapper is needed. This closes only the alias header; it does not certify full underlying class or forward-declared Mobilogram behavior.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/METADATA/Pepti.scope: Vec<PeptideIdentification> supplies all container data operations, constructors and assignment. Rust ownership, checked access and std::mem replace C++ moved-from-object/iterator observability; no C++ ABI or exact allocator capacity parity. Underlying PeptideIdentification and downstream algorithm completeness remain separate reviews.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/DATASTRUCTURES.scope: Every public delegated vector operation maps to Vec<T>, slices/iterators, trait-based comparison and std::mem operations; exact method-by-method mapping in documentation. Uses native allocation/byte limits instead of allocator-specific max_size, safe access instead of undefined indexing, and Rust ownership instead of template inheritance/moved-from inspection. This is a native container equivalent, not generic C++ ABI emulation.

All three aliases map to Vec<i32>, Vec<f64> and Vec<String>; arbitrary C++ byte strings can use Vec<Vec<u8>> without lossy UTF-8 conversion. Alias mapping does not imply ListUtils/StringUtils or all metadata API completion.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/CONCEPT/Types..scope: Fixed-width/native-size primitives and all15 ASCII names have native mappings. Whole time_t ABI and writtenDigits helper are not ported: includes generic fallback6, explicit long-to-int precision quirks and platform-specific long-double specialization. f32/f64 DIGITS alone cannot certify the whole header.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/DATASTRUCTURES.scope: Native borrowed/indirect views represent its primary use, but custom base-container/type-aware equality, size-only ordering, cached capacity, swap retaining identity/cache, null slots and custom iterator state are not represented. Do not classify the full header as Vec<&T> equivalence.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/TextFil.scope: Complete source operations with literal text/CSV semantics, source construction/load differences and native checked UTF-8/resource/I/O adaptations. No RFC CSV parsing promise.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/CsvFile.scope: Complete source operations with literal text/CSV semantics, source construction/load differences and native checked UTF-8/resource/I/O adaptations. No RFC CSV parsing promise.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/DATASTRUCTURES.scope: All public entry/node/tree, iterator, restrictions, defaults, update/copy/merge and CLI operations. Native full-value equality plus explicit checked source_equal; diagnostics replace logging and safe bounded errors replace undefined state.

All seven value alternatives, native constructors/conversions/ownership, source text/default-stream formatting, comparisons and explicit 64-bit little-endian source hashing with checked numerical adaptations.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/ParamXM.scope: Source plain/gzip/bzip2 load and atomic load-into, plain file/stdout store and stream surface through 1.8.0, scalar/list types, nested sections, tags/restrictions and legacy formats. ZIP input remains unsupported. Native encoding/precision/loss validation adaptations documented; inherited XMLFile schema APIs remain separate.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/DATASTRUCTURES.scope: Full defined generic conversion/formatting, membership/index, tolerance and string-case utilities through native functions and traits; checked UTF-8 and numeric/range boundaries.
Full prefix/suffix search with trim/ranges and ASCII case conversion; native slices and checked ranges replace C++ iterator overloads.

Current/default parameters, descriptions, subsections, flags, source equality, both initialization/replacement lifecycles and leaf-name metadata export. Pure return-value callbacks replace derived updateMembers; transaction errors prevent typed-state desynchronization.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/OPTIONS.scope: Every passive field, constructor default, get/set and has-range operation maps to the owned public options record with Option ranges. Reader semantics independently tested, including half-open filters, metadata-only early stop and the source size_only no-op.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/Feature.scope: Native load/store, count-only load and owned options, recursive geometry, typed metadata, identification runs/evidence and portable chemistry; plain/gzip/bzip2 input. Source ZIP input remains unsupported. Generic inherited XMLFile schema and ProgressLogger APIs remain separate; documented checked representation boundaries and corrected subordinate metadata ownership apply.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/Consens.scope: Native load/store and the three range options consumed by the source handler, centroid/handle geometry, typed metadata, protein group quantities, identification references and portable chemistry; plain/gzip/bzip2 input. Source ZIP input remains unsupported. Full passive PeakFileOptions and generic inherited XMLFile/ProgressLogger APIs remain separate. Quantity ownership failures default to a checked error with explicit source-compatible discard mode.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/Modific.scope: All nine public declarations: definition selection, per-run collection from slices/iterators and both feature-map overloads including recursive subordinates, deterministic codec/union, run encoding and registration. Owned registries, checked conflicts/portable representation, recovery diagnostics and cumulative budgets replace raw-pointer/global-mutation semantics. Full ResidueModification and ProForma parsing remain separate.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/SYSTEM/File.h.scope: Native entry points cover all 39 source function names and 40 overloads, including owned temp lifetimes, resource/config discovery and filesystem operations. Native glob subset does not reproduce POSIX locale classes/collation or Windows PathMatchSpec semantics; no-clobber directory/symlink rename and cross-device directory moves remain checked unsupported. Permission probes use native filesystem behavior rather than exact platform ACL emulation.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/CONCEPT/Progre.scope: All modes, copy/replacement/options and four backend operations, nested whole-second throttling, independent next counter and command timing/rates. Owned per-logger GUI factories, shared atomic nesting and mutable Rust calls replace global/raw-pointer/const mutation. Real total process CPU on Unix/Windows and monotonic elapsed wall timing; source undefined timing/range cases are checked errors. Default GUI is a no-op as in core; product GUI is outside this header.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/CONCEPT/LogStr.scope: Native owned streams/sinks/notifications/guards, source 32K buffering, partial flush, two-entry duplicate cache, all prefix tokens and nine ANSI styles, five global/TLS routes and location macros. Pointer/streambuf ownership maps to safe Write/callbacks. Automatic Windows console VT mode and process-exit flushing of directly buffered global streams remain absent; general Colorizer is a separate header. Explicit global finish and source-style macro flushing are available.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/FASTAFi.scope: All entry, aggregate, streaming, seek, output-lifecycle and inherited progress operations; original PEFF prologue/modified-sequence/description/80-byte writer rules. Owned records, bounded cumulative input/work, UTF-8 field representation, checked header output and atomic owned read results are explicit native differences. Plain source path transport; no PEFF semantic interpretation.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/HANDLER.scope: Both public decoder operations: configurable bounded footer probe and owned spectrum/chromatogram offset vectors. Source scanner, order/duplicate/replacement behavior retained; checked 63-bit offsets, small-file reads and bounded UTF-8 XML correct unchecked/undefined source behavior. Compact XML preserves the first offset rather than reproducing the DOM sibling bug. Index payload decoding, checksums and writing are separate classes.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/KERNEL/MSExper.scope: Native container/search/filter/TIC and complete aggregate/extractXICs custom/default/matrix operation group, with source f32/f64 arithmetic and shared bounds. Area traversal/exports/rasterization, ion mobility, full acquisition metadata, binned TIC and remaining specialized operations still require implementation/review. Checked source TIC resampling, chromatogram/combined ranges, stable aligned chromatogram sorting, total peak count, exact-level/zero-intensity predicates and spectrum-only metadata-array clearing are represented; mobility and full range/area APIs remain.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/MzMLFil.scope: Bounded read/write and path dispatch, represented arrays/precursors, referenceable parameters, chromatogram Product transport and hasIndex probe. read_with_load_options executes source RT/MS-level/selected-ion/point filters with aligned sorting and deferred float narrowing;26 canonical auxiliary binary roles have reversible native names. Full metadata/header/loadSize/transform/consumer/isolation-target paths, binary-array processing metadata, schema/CV validation, Numpress, indexed writing and full experimental/acquisition/spectrum-product transport remain.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/METADATA/Produ.scope: All own Product operations now have native equivalents, including equality-compatible Hash with signed-zero normalization, scalar mutation and cloning. Attached CV/ordinary metadata use native owned string-keyed records; inherited full source state remains limited by CVTerm/DataValue independent units and numeric registry identity. mzML transports represented fields and rejects arbitrary CV/list/Empty metadata before output. Full inherited source-model equivalence remains under review.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/KERNEL/Peak1D..scope: Construction/default/copy/equality, public scalar coordinate/intensity fields, comparator behavior, Display label layout and signed-zero-normalized standard Hash. Rust numeric formatting and caller-selected Hasher replace C++ stream formatting and implementation-dependent std::hash values. PartialEq remains nonreflexive for NaN; no Eq or direct HashMap-key guarantee.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/KERNEL/Chromat.scope: Construction/default/copy/equality, public scalar coordinate/intensity fields, comparator behavior, Display label layout and signed-zero-normalized standard Hash. Rust numeric formatting and caller-selected Hasher replace C++ stream formatting and implementation-dependent std::hash values. PartialEq remains nonreflexive for NaN; no Eq or direct HashMap-key guarantee.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/OPTIONS.scope: Complete source value/options API: all scalar defaults, four range activation rules, signed ordered MS levels, filter predicate, three Numpress configurations and warning identity. Native owned state and checked vector cap. This does not execute filters, codecs or output choices in format adapters.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/CHEMISTRY/MASS.scope: Complete source symbol-count value API, including literal-space parsing, duplicate historical maxima, distinct addition cache semantics, formatting, source map ordering, text equality, tag containment and compatibility. Owned ASCII keys, checked nonnegative counts/overflow and bounded output replace unsafe source states. Separate mass decomposition algorithms and solvers are not covered.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/FORMAT/IdXMLFi.scope: Native idXML document read/write and direct path load/store, document identifier, registry/options overloads, bounded plain/gzip/bzip2 input and source plain output regardless of suffix. Checked output extension and atomic file/destination replacement. Existing metadata/sequence encoding boundaries, source hit-order/rank differences, ZIP and inherited logger/schema/CV APIs remain.

src/openms/include/OpenMS/CHEMISTRY/MASS.scope: Complete scientific getDecompositions operation and five settings through owned typed configuration, atomic reconfiguration and append. Native private integer residue tables, GCD/rounding and real-mass filtering retain source order, exclusive upper bound and documented finite infinity-sentinel limitation. Checked numeric/resource boundaries replace unsafe states. Inherited C++ DefaultParamHandler APIs and standalone public IMS utility classes are separate.
